New man Shaun Moralee was now into action. He only took up athletics at age 17 and ran to 1:55 for 800 in his first season.
Could Shaun Moralee improve our fortunes? He’s a very talented young 1500m man and having seen young Nick do the business would have liked to have turned in something similar.

Third place and right in the firing line of some very swift men was possibly not a position that sat comfortably with Shaun Moralee. He was almost instantly up into second, gunning down the Medway man, but had the Beagles’ Keith Gerrard, Harrow’s Adam Bowden, Blackheath’s Andy Rayner and Mitch Goose…
And in the ‘B’ team, Paul Freary had run 19:09 on three followed by Graeme Hyett just a second slower on four and then Shaun Moralee exactly matching Graeme’s time on five.
S Moralee 9:00 (4th fastest). 18 Shell Four Villages Half Marathon, Helsby.
